ticket.body:
Difficulty: medium

## Why
The health endpoint reports: the bank holds 0 copper and 65 of 76 members hold under a gold each.

## What
Find why the health endpoint reports this problem and fix the cause, so the problem stops for everything it affects.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The pull request names the cause with the numbers that show it.
- [ ] A test fails without the fix and passes with it.
- [ ] Live: the finding is absent from the health endpoint for 24 hours.

## Size
M

## Out of scope
- Anything else.
